fields.description: Issue includes commentary on the May 3 city election and anticipated runoffs, discussion of Miami and Miami Beach civic affairs (including city commission candidates and calls for governmental change), and coverage of Tallahassee legislative activity. Recurring columns and satire appear (e.g., "Little Geraldine" items and "Round the Town"), alongside reports and humor related to Prohibition enforcement, federal court proceedings, and local nightlife/entertainment (including mention of Jimmy Hodges' Follies). The issue also contains local business and development promotion, including Coral Gables home-building and permit activity, plus advertisements for Miami-area services and venues.
